answer: A single controller can mint many sockpuppet farmers. Each applicant is assigned one cadastral orchard terrace and must open a tagged river flume for a single published irrigation slot, then walk a sealed soil core along a flagged ridge path to the clerk's bench. Clerks post H=sha3_256(addr||plot_id||flume_id||slot||core_root||path_mark). Fee is 0.29 POA; 14 POA bonds for eight epochs. Auditors match the core's pollen to the orchard cultivar list and the flume ticket to the slot clock. A reused plot, swapped core, or off-path walk seizes the bond and blinds both keys for twelve epochs.
